== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Jisu''' is named after the character Tomoyo Daidouji (whose localized Korean name is Sin Ji-su) from [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cardcaptor_Sakura Cardcaptor Sakura].

=== Individual Awards ===
* LLA Best Import Player (Closing 2020)
* LLA All Pro Team x2 (Opening 2020, Closing 2020)
* LLA Most Weekly MVPs in his role in the split x2 (Opening 2020, Closing 2020)
